# EXYZ.Studio

> EXYZ.Studio is a game art and UA creative studio for mobile games. One team builds game-ready art (characters, environments, Spine animation) and the UA creatives that sell it (video hooks, trailers, HTML5 playable ads), all from the same source files. EU-based, remote-first, works with studios worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.exyz.studio/): overview, clients, entry pilots, FAQ
- [Game Art](https://www.exyz.studio/asset-production): 2D concept art, character design, environments, Spine animation, weekly deliveries
- [Video Creatives](https://www.exyz.studio/video-creatives): UA video hooks, AI-video / UGC-style and gameplay-based creatives, trailers
- [Playables](https://www.exyz.studio/playables): custom HTML5 playable ads, interactive video, proven-mechanic playables, variant lines, live demos
- [Pricing](https://www.exyz.studio/pricing): fixed-price pilots and monthly retainers
- [Case study: Shiba Story Go!](https://www.exyz.studio/case/shiba-story-go): 60+ characters and bosses, 8+ levels, 500+ UA creatives for Proof of Play on a weekly cadence
- [AI Policy](https://www.exyz.studio/ai-policy): how AI is and is not used, No-AI mode, per-asset log
- [Contact](https://www.exyz.studio/contact): brief form and discovery call booking

## Pilots (fixed price, fixed date)

- Hook Sprint: 10 UA video hooks in 3 working days, $1,000. Hooks that don't pass the client's internal review are replaced free.
- Playable Pilot: 1 custom HTML5 playable + 3 variants, exported for Meta, Google, AppLovin, Unity, Mintegral, Moloco, under 5 MB. 2–3 working days (from 1 day for reskins), $450.
- Style Match Test: 1 production-ready character in the client's style, 5 working days, $400. Up to 2 revision rounds on written feedback, then a full refund if the style is still missed.
- Interactive Video: from $250.

## Retainers (cancel monthly)

- Creative Retainer: from $4,000/month, 10 to 80 UA creatives a month.
- Playable Line: from $3,000/month, 10 or 16 new playables a month.
- Art Department: from $5,000/month.

## Facts

- Clients include eRepublik Labs, Gismart, Proof of Play, MADBOX, Cubic Games.
- Genres: strategy, battlers, puzzle, RPG, casual.
- Reply time: same business day, EU hours.
- Source files belong to the client from day one. Network spec misses are fixed free.
- Next available start is usually within a few business days.
